title: Chapter 117
text:
Moonlight walked on the streets expressionlessly. He had already circled the White Gull branch of Division 13 a few times.

He said he was patrolling, and he was a man of his word.

The cold moonlight shone on his body and seemed to be absorbed by his body, forming a faint silvery white light on the surface of his body. It was magnificent yet ethereal, giving him an otherworldly temperament.

After walking past a deserted alley, Moonlight suddenly turned around and activated [Moon Power], forming a white light armor around his body. His ability used the power of moonlight to increase his physical strength.

His eyes turned silvery white, and his fist, which was wrapped in lustrous light, struck the air, and actually hit a solid object.

"Who are you?" Moonlight shouted.

Under the silver Radiance, a human figure appeared in the air.

…

In the last bit of darkness before dawn, Han Xiao brought Tang Shu, who was foaming at the mouth, back to the abandoned factory and returned the antiques to Li Xin.

You have completed [Returning Antiques]!

Number of participants: 1

Number of participants: 1

You have returned ten antiques. You have received 100% of the prize pool reward.

You have received 102000 EXP.

There were no competitors for this mission, so it was not difficult for him at all.

Han Xiao looked at the interface. He had accumulated 700,000 EXP over the past few days!

With the EXP in hand, Han Xiao turned around and left, waving his hand without taking a single cloud with him.

Li Xin suddenly remembered that she had not asked for Han Xiao's name. She felt lost. She felt that Han Xiao was like the prince in her dreams. He would appear when she was in trouble, help her, and then leave quietly.

Tang Shu squatted in the corner and drew circles. "I don't want to see you ever again," he mumbled.

The sky turned bright.

Han Xiao, who was walking on the street, found a shop window and used it as a mirror. Only then did he see the face of the Face Simulator. He was shocked and said, "Damn, so handsome."

"… But it's not as good as my real face."

Han Xiao curled his lips and saved this face.

At this moment, Han Xiao saw a pair of indifferent eyes appear in the air behind him through the reflection of the mirror.

…

Inside Mo Ran's office in the Seagull City branch of Division 13 …

"Three assassins died last night. They are Moonlight, Volcano, and Hunter." Di Su Su reported to Mo Ran.

"Their wounds are very similar. They were cut by a sharp weapon at high speed, pierced through the heart, and slit the throat. There were signs of resistance before they died. However, according to the clues collected from the surroundings, the battle lasted no more than ten seconds. These three killers are not weak. Moonlight is a psychic, and his ability is to absorb the Radiance of the Moon to increase his physical strength. The murderer was able to approach these three killers silently.

"Do you have a video?"

"There are no surveillance cameras in the area where the accident happened. Perhaps the murderer deliberately chose this location."

Mo Ran said in a deep voice, "Are there any suspicious targets?"

Di Su Su's tone was solemn. "He has the ability to conceal himself and has extraordinary speed. He can easily kill elite assassins and Espers. There is a person in the Great Threat Target file that matches him … Hidden Demon!"

Wang Yuan's face darkened. "It's him!"

Hidden Demon, a terrifying killer and psychic criminal. He was once a death row criminal in Raylan and was chosen as a test subject for a research project. As a result, his body mutated. Other than his eyes, his skin and hair gained a strong ability to conceal himself and change according to the environment. He was basically an invisible person.

Not only that, Hidden Demon also awakened his own psychic ability, super reaction and agility. Using his invisibility and psychic ability, he escaped from Raylan and became active in the underground world, becoming a mysterious killer.

Wang Yuan was expressionless, but his eyes were cold. The price to hire Hidden Demon was astronomical. How much money did those traitors embezzle from the organization?

Although Hidden Demon's ability was good at assassination, Bennett did not find it difficult. His five senses had been specially trained and were very sharp. Even if he could not see, his hearing, smell, and touch were all extended senses. He would not let Hidden Demon get within ten meters of Wang Yuan.

Wang Yuan pondered. "Hidden Demon might want to get rid of my guards first. My people are most likely dead. Mo Ran, please tell the people following me to gather now."

"Golden Fox is resting in the hotel, but that Mr. Black got rid of his pursuers." Di Su Su was helpless.

Wang Yuan was stunned and sighed helplessly. "Please send someone to find him … Sigh, as long as you do your best."

Hidden Demon was a sniper's natural enemy. Even Bennett felt that Han Xiao was most likely dead. Although he liked Han Xiao, he was responsible for protecting Wang Yuan and could not help him. He could only pray that Han Xiao was on his own.

…

The moment he saw the pair of eyes, Han Xiao immediately controlled the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor to cover the back of his neck and back. The next moment, a series of sparks flew from the armor as if it was cut by a sharp weapon more than ten times in the blink of an eye.

He already knew the danger of the fifth round of the mission, so he was ready to fight at any time. Therefore, he reacted immediately.

The force of the impact came from behind, and Han Xiao was thrown forward into the shop, shattering all the glass on the floor.

The enemy is invisible! Han Xiao realized the problem the moment he was ambushed.

Falling into the shop, the sense of danger followed him like a shadow. The sound of someone moving quickly entered Han Xiao's ears. Han Xiao immediately slid back, took out his guns, and fired. He aimed at the direction of the sound of wind, but he hit nothing. The shelves were destroyed, and bullet holes appeared on the wall.

The invisible enemy hit the armor again, and the sound of friction was heard.

"So fast!" Han Xiao could only rely on his reaction to control the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor to block the attack. Fortunately, the armor covered three-quarters of his body, so as long as it protected his vitals, the enemy's threat was greatly reduced.

The damage value that appeared on the interface showed that the enemy was in a high agility combat mode. Han Xiao looked at the combat information and learned the name of the assassin.

"Hidden Demon!" Han Xiaoxin was shocked and felt troubled.

Just like Black Spider, Hidden Demon was also on the "Blue Star Most Difficult Boss List of Version 1.0" list. With the combination of invisibility and super agility, he was a natural close-range assassin.

"Hidden Demon is level forty-four, and his agility is the highest. His invisibility should only be targeted at himself, so the weapon he used to attack me could only be his fingernails. Furthermore, he is running around naked. This person is so unhygienic.

My speed is not as fast as his. His agility is more focused on short-distance sprinting and dodging. Long-distance sprinting should not be his strong suit. I can use the Hover-boots to escape … but if I escape like this, there will be another assassination attempt. I should try and see if I can kill him first. To deal with him, I have to slow him down first! "

In an instant, many thoughts flashed through Han Xiao's mind. His eyes became cold, and he entered his unique battle mode.

Again and again, Han Xiao used the magnetic retractable armor to block the attacks. Sparks flew everywhere, and he took out a bunch of small mechanical bees the size of candy from the inner lining of his clothes. He threw them around, and these mechanical bees flew up, shining with electric light.

Shock Bees, also known as Bee Swarm, had stingers that carried high volts of electricity. When they came into contact with a human body, they could temporarily cause paralysis. Many Shock Bees could even form a layer of electric net, which could be used as a control skill. This was the blueprint that Han Xiao had accidentally obtained when he was developing the Hover-boots.

A swarm of Shock Bees flew around the narrow area of the shop, and the effect was immediate.

Hidden Demon could dodge the attacks with his speed, but his movement was restricted, and his attack frequency was reduced.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

Han Xiao never stopped firing his guns, but he dodged all the attacks. Hidden Demon was faster than Pan Kuang. If even Pan Kuang could dodge the bullets, Hidden Demon could do better.

"You are good at dodging, aren't you? Let's see who has more HP!"
